The Integration table names no corpus reference: all six rows are borrowed-through authors or bodies (Freeman, Christensen, Granovetter, Pfeffer and Salancik, B Lab, Ethics Resource Center), while openstax-principles-management (Freeman's stakeholder theory), openstax-business-ethics (stakeholder prioritisation, social contract, CSR) and openstax-principles-marketing are held and relevant. Recurring passing mentions graded FAITHFUL because the named cycle-to-deep covers them: 'dispute resolution by gut feel' at line 128 (E007).
